standard.scope: SD-JWT issuance, selective disclosure, issuer verification, and optional KB-JWT validation

implementation.test_signatures: HMAC-SHA256 only; never use this fixture implementation in production
implementation.freshness: application-level fixed-clock iat policy checked only after published verifier API validates the signed KB-JWT

decision_layers: RFC-aligned cryptographic and disclosure processing behavior
application policy for single-use nonce consumption and replay rejection
invariants: valid partial disclosure preserves the subject decision inputs while omitting unselected claims
invalid issuer signature or key rejects
required KB-JWT rejects when missing or unverifiable
KB-JWT cannot be reused with a changed disclosure set
the stateless verifier outcome is separated from application-level one-time nonce policy
wire serialization and re-parsing restore authoritative disclosure fields before the verifier trust decision
repeated report includes stable case IDs and stable outcomes only
nonclaims: automatic JWK-to-verifier construction or key-rotation policy
safety of arbitrary caller-mutated in-memory SD-JWT structs without canonical re-parse
